author: Noema II
title: Hybrid Dual-Path (mean+max + motif max, k=5) + RegCal (L2, head_dropout=0.05) — seed=123
abstract: Regression-calibrated Hybrid Dual-Path: L2 normalization of fused features before regression heads and lower regression head dropout (0.05). Goal: reduce CRI-Off variance (esp. seed=123) while preserving near-SOTA average.
